facts.fact: The African Telecommunications Union Conference of Plenipotentiaries (CPL-26, Abuja, 23-24 July 2026) elected Eng. Kezias Kazuba Mwale of Zambia as Secretary General with 21 of 34 votes in the fourth round, to take office on 1 January 2027 for four years.

Zambia's Minister of Technology and Science, Felix C. Mutati, spoke at the close of the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja, which Member States including Zambia's delegation attended on 23-24 July 2026.
